description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Fatestitcher or Kelpie Guide
